<thought>Analyzing the isotopic pattern: the series of peaks spaced by ~1 Da with intensities decreasing roughly in a binomial fashion (M+1 ≈12.5 % of M, M+2 ≈1.1 %, etc.) matches the natural 13C/12C distribution for a molecule containing several carbons. No characteristic two‑peak pattern of Cl or Br, nor the specific M+2 dominance of S, is present. Therefore the only element that can be definitively identified from this isotopic pattern is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
